mechanisms.text: Four conversational query styles are defined: dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed. Gold answers and evidence dia_ids are kept fixed from the original LoCoMo QA pool.
Dataset construction includes query rewriting, composed-cluster mining and extension, leakage repair, and rewrite validation.

ledger.claim: The benchmark covers four query styles: dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed.
ledger.quote: LoCoMo-Conv recasts the LoCoMo QA pool into four conversational query styles — dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The composed split contains 1,069 multi-memory clusters, each built from two source QAs.
ledger.quote: data/locomo10_multimem_full.json | 1,069 composed multi-memory clusters (two source QAs each)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Dataset construction includes a leakage repair step to prevent train/test contamination.
ledger.quote: construction/ — dataset construction: query rewriting (rewrite_qa_to_dialog.py), composed-cluster mining and extension, leakage repair, rewrite validation.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Counterfactual queries are judged with a 3-way LLM judge (score_counterfactual_3way.py).
ledger.locator: README.md, Repository layout section and Typical pipeline section
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Composed queries are judged atomically per sub-memory using score_composed_atomic.py, referencing locomo10_multimem_full.json.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Pairwise response quality is judged along three dimensions using claude-opus-4-7.
ledger.quote: Pairwise quality judge: claude-opus-4-7 ... pairwise three-dimension judges
ledger.locator: README.md, Setup section and Repository layout section
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Memory systems evaluated include BM25, dense retrieval, A-MEM, mem0, AnchorMem, Memora, and Nemori.
ledger.quote: Memory systems (A-MEM, mem0, AnchorMem, Memora, Nemori) are installed from their own repositories; the run scripts in retrieval/ follow each system's distributed implementation
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The benchmark is published in Findings of ACL: EMNLP 2026.
ledger.quote: booktitle={Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026}
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: LoCoMo-Conv recasts the LoCoMo QA pool into four conversational query styles (dialog, implicit, counterfactual, composed) with gold answers and evidence dia_ids preserved.
ledger.quote: LoCoMo-Conv recasts the LoCoMo QA pool into four conversational query styles — dialog, implicit, counterfactual, and composed — while keeping the original gold answers and evidence dia_ids fixed
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Each QA entry in the dialog rewrite file includes dialog_query, implicit_query, counterfactual_query, expected_memory_use, and supportive_memory fields.
ledger.quote: data/locomo10_dialog.json — LoCoMo-Conv: per-QA conversational rewrites (dialog_query, implicit_query, counterfactual_query, expected_memory_use, supportive_memory)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: Response quality is judged by LLM judges with style-specific scripts: partial fact-used for dialog/implicit, 3-way for counterfactual, atomic for composed.
ledger.quote: LLM judges (score_fact_used_partial.py, score_counterfactual_3way.py, score_composed_atomic.py, hallucination, pairwise three-dimension judges, cross-judge agreement)
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The benchmark is published as Findings of ACL EMNLP 2026.
ledger.quote: booktitle={Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026}
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: The underlying conversations and QA annotations originate from LoCoMo (Maharana et al., 2024); LoCoMo-Conv adds conversational rewrites, composed clusters, and supportive_memory annotations.
ledger.quote: The underlying conversations and QA annotations come from LoCoMo (Maharana et al., 2024); LoCoMo-Conv adds the conversational rewrites, composed clusters, and supportive_memory annotations on top.
ledger.label: measured

ledger.claim: top_k value of 10 is used as default in retrieval (example pipeline uses --top_k 10).
ledger.label: inferred

ledger.claim: Implicit and composed queries expose larger retrieval gaps compared to QA benchmarks.
ledger.quote: conversational framing exposes substantial retrieval gaps overlooked by QA benchmarks, especially on implicit and composed queries.
ledger.label: inferred
